title: S01 evaluation label set (SPIKE SCHEMA)
description: Spike schema for S01 (#11) manual labels and the tuning/held-out split. NOT a canonical contract: it is to be superseded by, or aligned with, the canonical schemas owned by T02 (#18). Real labels are kept outside git; only synthetic fixtures (synthetic: true) are committed. Constraints JSON Schema cannot express (end_ms > start_ms, disjoint split ranges, unique segment refs, every segment inside exactly one split range) are enforced by spikes/s01-labels.

schema_version.description: Spike schema version. Bump on any breaking change.

sample_id.description: Opaque identifier for the labelled sample. Must not contain player names or dates that identify people.

synthetic.description: true for invented fixture data. Files committed to git must be synthetic.

session_ref.description: Opaque reference to the recorded session. The mapping to the real session lives outside git.

labeller_role.description: Role of the person who labelled. Never a real name.

labelled_on.description: Calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) the labelling was done.

consent_ref.description: Pointer to the consent provenance record kept OUTSIDE git (e.g. 'outside-git:consent-2026-11-s01'). The consent itself, signatures, names and messages are never stored here.

transcript_ref.description: Opaque reference to the whisper.cpp transcript run the segment refs were taken from (S04 setup).

time_base.description: All times are integer milliseconds on the shared session timeline (offset applied per track).

speakerId.description: Pseudonymous speaker/track id (e.g. 'gm', 'p1'). Never a real name.

ms.description: Integer milliseconds on the session timeline.

label.description: ic = in-character speech; narration = GM description/NPC framing of the fiction; rules = mechanics talk; ooc = out-of-character table talk; mixed = one segment combining recap-relevant and irrelevant content; uncertain = labeller cannot decide.

outcome_basis.description: Required when type = outcome. 'roll' = only the mechanical result was spoken; 'narrative' = the GM narrated what happened.

summary.description: Short neutral restatement of the critical item (what a recap must mention).

text.description: Optional transcript text. Only allowed in git for synthetic fixtures.

end_ms.description: Exclusive end. Ranges are half-open [start_ms, end_ms).

splitManifest.description: Tuning/held-out split by session time ranges. Every labelled segment must fall inside exactly one range; tuning and held-out ranges must be disjoint (checked by the validator). Held-out segments must never be shown to a prompt-tuning loop.

excluded.description: Optional ranges deliberately left out of both subsets (e.g. a buffer around the boundary).

frozen_on.description: Date the split was fixed. It must not change after prompt tuning starts.

method.description: How the split was chosen (e.g. 'contiguous blocks, chosen before looking at model output').
